answer: Clawback vesting at the nectar: rewards accrue but stay locked for 30 epochs, forfeited if any linked identity is flagged. The meadow maps every payout to a unique stake lineage, so one operator farming k identities must lock k stakes through the canyon of overlapping windows. Attacker cost scales linearly per identity while yield stays flat, so profit dies before ten sybils. Delayed vesting works because sybil farms need fast liquidity and can't survive the lockup.
